name: com.dvmms.dejapay.terminals.DvPaymentActivity
description: The DejaPay (iPOS Systems/Dejavoo) payment SDK opens this Activity for terminal transactions, sends payment details to the selected Dejavoo terminal app, and returns the result; Dejavoo can also open it for terminal registration.
disableEffect: The app cannot start or complete Dejavoo terminal payments or handle registration through this integration.
